modmenu.descriptionTranslation.gizmoclie: A client-side Minecraft mod that bundles small, configurable quality-of-life tweaks for vanilla gameplay.
gui.gizmoclienttweaks.cloth_config_warni:
Installing §lCloth Config API§r allows you to edit this mod's configuration through a graphical interface, but it doesn't appear to be installed.

Don't worry! You can still edit the %s file manually, then click the §a§lLoad Config§r button below to reload the configuration.
config.gizmoclienttweaks.remove_realms_b: Removes the Realms button from the title screen
config.gizmoclienttweaks.language_code_f: Allows searching for languages using codes like `en_US` or `enUS` in the language selection screen
config.gizmoclienttweaks.hide_fire_overl: Hides the screen fire overlay if the player has Fire Resistance or is in Creative Mode
config.gizmoclienttweaks.hide_insecure_w: Hides the toast warning that the server is not secure when joining a server
config.gizmoclienttweaks.unfocused_fps_l: Limits the frame rate when the game window is not focused.
Mutes all game audio while the game window is not focused
config.gizmoclienttweaks.client_ping_ref: How often the client refreshes its ping measurement, in seconds. Values outside 1-29 disable this feature
config.gizmoclienttweaks.numeric_ping.@t: Shows the ping value as a number in the player list instead of only the connection bars
config.gizmoclienttweaks.numeric_ping.en: Replaces the connection bars in the player list with the numeric ping value
config.gizmoclienttweaks.numeric_ping.sh: Shows the connection icon next to the numeric ping value
config.gizmoclienttweaks.numeric_ping.sl: Extra width in pixels added to each player list slot to make room for the ping value
config.gizmoclienttweaks.numeric_ping.ru: Color rules applied to the ping value. The first matching rule is used
Ping range this rule matches, e.g. `>=100 <=200`. Use `*` to match any ping
Color used for the ping value when this rule matches
config.gizmoclienttweaks.mixins.warning: §c§lWarning:§r Only disable a Mixin if you fully understand its purpose and the consequences. Disabling a Mixin will completely disable its associated functionality and may cause unexpected behavior or compatibility issues.
